scope: Read-only source/evidence review and independent diagnostic harness review; no hosted queries or SQL execution.
observed_timeout_contexts: PC scope_item_ids body line6 via jobsheet_page_ids
inferences_and_limits: Actual server57014 stacks show database cancellation; browser symptoms alone do not explain the cause.
Fast one-connection auto-mode results do not exclude a differently cached pooled PL/pgSQL plan.
Component extraction substitutes constants and cannot prove pooled parameter-sensitive behavior.
Worker scope predicate lacks live-row filters; current catalog only shows a partial assigned_worker index with those filters. This is a possible cost contributor, not a proven timeout root cause.
Adding live predicates for index use could change historical authority and is not an approved optimization.
A forced generic/custom difference would demonstrate sensitivity, not prove the original pooled connection chose the generic plan.
